values.note: Full hookup with wifi, plus tax: 30-amp $47, 50-amp $50 a night; weekly $296/$315, monthly $725/$795 (rates effective 1/1/2025).

fees.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/rates ('CAMPGROUND RATES (effective 1/1/2025)', 'DAILY 30 AMP $47 + TAX', 'DAILY 50 AMP $50 + TAX', 'Includes electric, water, sewer and wifi'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/rates ('ELECTRIC, WATER, AND SEWER', 'DAILY 50 AMP ... Includes electric, water, sewer and wifi'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/ and /rates, read 2026-10-22: the operator's pages say nothing about pull-through sites; the note-derived value is cleared

values.note: The bathhouse closes 11/15 to 4/1; the restroom at the office stays open year round.

facilities.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/ ('Our amenities include free WiFi, a clean bathhouse, laundry facility', 'Tent Sites, Cabins and Bathhouse closed 11/15 - 4/1 for the 2026/2027 season. Restroom at the office open year round.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: RV sites open year round; tent sites, cabins and the bathhouse close 11/15 to 4/1.

season.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/ ('*RVs welcome year round', 'RV sites open year round! Tent Sites, Cabins and Bathhouse closed 11/15 - 4/1 for the 2026/2027 season.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations required. Cancel 14+ days out for a full refund less $20; 14 to 7 days, 50% refund; under 7 days, no refund.

booking.source: https://mimountaincampground.com/ ('RESERVATIONS are REQUIRED!', 'BOOK online NOW' -> Firefly Reservations, nightly 'RV Full Hookup' unit type) + https://mimountaincampground.com/rates (cancellation policy), read 2026-10-22

note: Family campground in a wooded setting ~2.5 mi from downtown Franklin; also cabins, tent sites, and monthly/long-term sites. Pavilion, playground; cell tower on site (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile). --Claude
summary: Operator site and its Firefly booking engine: confirmed $47/$50 (+tax, effective 1/1/2025), full hookups to 50 amp, laundry, year-round RV sites; added showers and wifi, the seasonal bathhouse/tent/cabin closure (11/15-4/1), online booking and the cancellation policy. Cleared the note-derived pull-through (the operator never mentions it). Note trimmed of hookups, pull-throughs, 'big rigs OK', cable (the site offers wifi), laundry and year-round.
flags: Price gate: $47 + tax for 30 amp is under US$50 before tax (about $52 with NC sales/occupancy tax); in any case the park is 33 km from the Great Smoky Mountains NP gateway, inside the 40-km exception. The family has not stayed here. Presence passes: operator site with phone 828-524-6155 (matches the entry) and a Firefly booking engine; Google 4.6 stars from 136 reviews.

Long-stay character (mild, passes): the home page advertises 'monthly and longterm sites for those looking to get out of the Florida heat or relocating to the area', but a nightly rate is posted and the booking engine sells nightly stays, so tests 2 and 4 look satisfied; the nightly share of sites could not be measured.
Name: Google lists it as 'Mi Mountain Campground and RV Park'; the operator's site uses 'Mi Mountain Campground'. Not changed.
